verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit gives you ways to tune down noise. It learns preferences from chat feedback, supports path and AST-scoped instructions, and has auto-review controls for pausing, skipping drafts and filtering by label or branch. Re-running a review checks only new changes, which limits repeat comments. Community reports are mixed: one user calls the reviews clean and actionable, while another team removed it as too verbose with too many false positives. Missing for 10: evidence of severity labels on comments, explicit deduplication of comments, measured false-positive rates, and independent corroboration that noise stays low.
